name: pr-pane
description: Live pane of the current repo's open PRs via gh: approval, mergeability, reviewers, toasts for new PRs, and review/merge actions with agentic-PR guardrails

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at session start
autoOpen.description: Off by default: the pane opens only on /prs. /prs autoOpen enable or disable sets this too. The poll and new-PR toasts run either way.
